overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures dehydrated Kalmegh Powder derived from selected Andrographis paniculata botanicals. Produced in our FSSAI-registered Indian facility, each batch undergoes a thorough six-step manufacturing process. We ensure dependable consistency across particle sizing and moisture control. Our processing retains the natural characteristics of the raw herb for diverse manufacturing applications across domestic and export commercial markets.

As an IEC-registered exporter, we offer scalable bulk supply alongside flexible OEM and private label services. The standard botanical powder features a fine 80 to 100 mesh profile with moisture levels strictly under 8 percent. We provide comprehensive export documentation support for international shipments. Buyers receive tailored milling options and uniform batch quality to support their specific formulation requirements.
highlights: Dehydrated botanical powder with 80 to 100 standard mesh size
Low moisture content maintained below 8 percent
Extended shelf life of 24 months from manufacture
FSSAI-registered manufacturing and IEC-registered export operation
Flexible minimum order quantity starting at 5 Kg
Custom grinding and packaging solutions available on request
packaging: Custom private-label retail pouches and jars

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for Kalmegh Powder?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity starts at 5 Kg to support pilot batches, specialized production runs, and large-scale bulk procurement.

faqs.q: Can you provide custom mesh sizes for our processing equipment?
faqs.a: Yes. While our standard specification is 80 to 100 mesh, we can adjust milling and sieving parameters to meet your custom requirements.

faqs.q: What packaging formats do you offer for bulk shipments?
faqs.a: We package product in 25 kg bags, HDPE containers, 5 to 10 kg bags, and small private-label retail pouches or jars.

faqs.q: Do you offer OEM and private label packaging services?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide complete OEM and private label packing services, including custom retail packaging and labeling to match your brand specifications.

faqs.q: What quality and processing controls are used during manufacturing?
faqs.a: We are an FSSAI-registered supplier following a six-step process including sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and dispatch.

faqs.q: Do you provide product samples and export documentation support?
faqs.a: Yes. As an IEC-registered exporter, we provide product samples upon request and furnish complete export documentation for international shipping.
